title: Search Completion — Certification
methodology: assets/js/food-ontology-search-index.js was parsed and every slug compared against a full census of every published domain's leaf/group/category catalog entries. wine-side search modules (taxonomy, wine-style, wine-region, wine-serving, winemaking-technique, wine-fault) were not modified, only additively imported into semantic-entry.js alongside the new food index.
